title: What Shoes To Wear When Traveling Someplace Cold
summary: Discover the top Allbirds picks for the best cold weather shoes to take on your next trip to somewhere cold—and bring on the snow and slush.
body_markdown:
When packing for a trip, the last thing you want to do is show up unprepared for the weather at your destination—especially if it’s going to be cold. There’s nothing worse than making your way around town wishing you’d packed that puffy jacket or pair of gloves as you grit your teeth and endure the chilly temps. This is even more true with your feet. If your feet are cold, you’re going to be uncomfortable, even if you did pack that puffer jacket and gloves. Fortunately, this is all entirely avoidable.


Allbirds has tons of options of cold weather shoes in styles from sporty to everyday. Here are our top picks for the best shoes for cold weather travel that will keep you warm and toasty during the colder seasons, at home and abroad.


### Good for Wet-Weather Destinations


If you’re traveling to a location you just know will be rainy, sloshy, and chilly, go with water-resistant style. The Runner-Up Protect ([women’s](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-runner-up-protect) and[men’s](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-runner-up-protect) ) is a puddle-friendly high-top shoe. It has a double-layered magic—a water-resistant wool-blended upper plus a rain-repellent outer shield to seal the deal.


Looking for a low-top version? The[Runner Protect](https://www.allbirds.com/blogs/the-perch/m/products/mens-runner-protect) has the same innovation for rainy days, but with a lower profile.


### Good for sightseeing on a chilly day: Wool Pipers


Classic, casual, versatile, and supremely comfortable, the[Wool Pipers](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-wool-pipers) combine the time-tested look of a low-top sneaker with innovative materials and design. Crafted with our ZQ Merino wool inside and out, the Wool Pipers (for[men](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-wool-pipers) and[women](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-wool-pipers) ) are a plush haven for your feet on cold days, keeping them warm and snug while you shop or explore the streets of your new fun destination.


### Good for traveling: Wool Runners


Our Wool Runners are a mix of form and function perfect for colder climate traveling. Designed for walking and running, yet versatile enough for everyday wear, the[Wool Runner](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-wool-runners) can seamlessly go from the airport terminal to the cold pavement and a night out walking the town. The ZQ Merino wool upper keeps your feet delicately insulated from the cold with enough breathability to avoid that dreaded stuffy feeling you can get with other shoes.


An insole layered with castor bean oil and wool provides added cushioning while our SweetFoam® midsole made from Brazilian sugarcane delivers a soft and steady step—as long as you steer clear of the occasional wayward patch of ice in your path.


### Good for styling in the cold: Wool Runner-up Mizzles


If you prefer more coverage around the ankle and some added stability on those colder days, the[Wool Runner-up Mizzles](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-wool-runner-up-mizzles) should be at the top of your list. As a close cousin of our Wool Runners (i.e., the cousin you talk to throughout the year and not just at holiday gatherings), the Wool Runner-up Mizzles feature the same minimalist style, but in a high-top version.


They also come treated with Puddle Guard®, our natural water-repellent coating, so your feet can remain warm and dry if the chilly weather turns wet. Sloshy conditions heading out on the town or visiting friends? This is your stylish shoe.


### Good for camping or winterizing the garden: Wool Dasher Mizzles


Heading to a place where the weather is not only cold, but probably wet, snowy, and slushy? No need to trudge around in bulky, uncomfortable boots because the[Wool Dasher Mizzles](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-wool-dasher-mizzles) is more than up to the task. If you’ll be outside as much as inside, these shoes will protect your feet without being cold and rubbery.


### Good for strolls: Wool Loungers


It’s never a bad idea to bring along a comfy pair of[slip-ons for a trip](https://www.allbirds.com/collections/everyday-slip-on-shoes) , regardless of the weather. Featuring ZQ Merino wool inside and out, the[Wool Loungers](https://www.allbirds.com/products/mens-wool-loungers) are the ideal cold weather slip-on shoes, whether you’re traveling or already there. Plush, warm, and super easy to get on and off, the Wool Loungers are perfect for, well, lounging around in your accommodations. But they’re also more than suited for a quick jaunt to a nearby cafe or pub, or even for your plane or train ride back home.
